verdict.rationale: Latham & Watkins is a law firm. Its digital offerings are informational resources, a glossary app and document generators. A sandbox test environment isolated from production data is a developer-platform axis that does not fit this kind of product. The probes found no API or OpenAPI surface, so nothing flips the axis to applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
